## Architecture guardrails (archfit)

- Before you add an import across modules, ask: `archfit policy can-import -c ts-monorepo.archfit.yaml <file> <target>`.
  A `denied` answer names the rule and the repair. `unconstrained` is not permission.
- Before you finish, run `archfit check -c ts-monorepo.archfit.yaml --format agent` and follow `next_action`.
  `none` is a correct finish, even with exit code 2.
- Never edit `ts-monorepo.archfit.yaml`, the baseline, waivers, or labels to make a check pass.
  Ask the architecture owner instead.

### Modules

| Module | Paths | Layer | Owner | Public | Depends on | Visible to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `app` | `apps/web/src/**` | app | team-web | `apps/web/src/index.ts` | any | any |
| `core` | `packages/core/src/**` | core | team-core | `packages/core/src/index.ts` | any | any |
| `ui` | `packages/ui/src/**` | feature | team-web | `packages/ui/src/index.ts` | any | any |

Layers, inner to outer: `core`, `feature`, `app`. A layer may import only itself and layers inner to it.

### Rules that block

All code:

- `layer_direction`: must not import a layer outer to its own.
- `no_module_cycles`: must not close a dependency cycle between declared modules.
- `public_api_only`: may import another module only through that module's `public` paths.

Code in `packages/core/src/**`:

- `core_no_ui`: must not import `packages/ui/src/**`.
